content.text:
This is our interpretation of your question:

What are the top 3 drivers of the group revenue change?

content.statement:
WITH __drivers AS (
  SELECT
    comparison,
    rank AS driver_rank,
    is_scope_total,
    scope_key,
    segment,
    change_inr,
    growth_rate,
    share_of_change
  FROM WIPRO_FINANCE_360_APP.APP_DATA.V_AGENT_DRIVERS
)
SELECT
  driver_rank,
  segment,
  is_scope_total,
  change_inr,
  share_of_change,
  growth_rate,
  comparison
FROM __drivers
WHERE
  scope_key = 'GROUP' AND driver_rank <= 3
ORDER BY
  driver_rank
